title: デビュー戦の後に・大型新人

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What a showing! Let's hear it for the star newcomer, Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order executed. I have returned, Master.
choice_data_list: That was an awesome debut race!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I was able to adequately display my current abilities.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Logging today's results and environmental data to my database. I will work even harder for the Triple Crown.
The next day, I overhear a familiar name coming from a TV in an electronics store while strolling through the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Television Announcer
text_block_list.text: Boasting overwhelming speed since even before entering the academy, Mihono Bourbon's the hottest newcomer on the block!

text_block_list.name: Television Announcer
text_block_list.text: She's one to keep an eye on in the future, folks! Was that a great debut or what?!
The news continues with some spectator interviews.

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: I've been following her career for a long time, so I was incredibly excited to finally watch her debut race!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: What a run! It's weird, but I felt exhilarated just from watching her!
I notice an Umamusume looking intently at the screen.
It's amazing how everyone's smiling when they talk about Bourbon… She's so cool!
If I can even come close to performing like that in the Twinkle Series…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Then maybe I'll finally be able to say goodbye to the Rice Shower that only brings misfortune and sadness to everyone…
Without interrupting her moment, I leave her alone to intently watch the screen.
